verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe AI insights from the user's own data in several places: Copilot in Excel and the Analyst agent turn raw data into insights, Outlook produces summaries, connectors let Copilot summarize and act on OneDrive and Gmail content, and Copilot runs code to generate graphs. Docs also say it proactively offers personalized suggestions based on memory and past queries, and one community user praises how it pulls data from across 365 documents. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation beyond marketing taglines for Excel/Analyst insight generation, and hands-on independent confirmation that the insights and suggestions are of good quality.
